sayAfter: You hold still behind cover. After a while, the sounds fade. It lost your trail.
The cold snap steals your warmth — breath smoking, fingers clumsy. (-20 kcal shivering. Fire, the hall, or your tent.)
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.

🌙 The night shift is out: Big Ugly and Captain Bright-Eyes. They own the dark — the cast turns over after sunset, and every step is riskier. A lit fire is a beacon — light through canvas, smoke on the wind. Sealed and dark, you're just a smell in the night. Haven's walls end every argument.

callLines.line: 📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.

anchoredLines.line: 🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 1 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Felix Ibrahim. From Emberhold." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
Build the board, day after day. The pattern will step forward.
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Emberhold in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold REFUSES. debts unpaid between you. (trust −8 — refusals are remembered.)
— Stonebridge REFUSES. debts unpaid between you. (trust −8 — refusals are remembered.)
— Thornfield answers! Theo Petrov and Zoe Weber will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)

🛡️ Sanne steps forward. They will march with the muster, eat from your stores (1000 kcal/day each), and stand in front of THE HERALD. They can die — Haven does not get them back, and the fire will be quieter. Tap again — Haven sends its own.
🛡️ Haven commits its own: Sanne marches with the muster. Not loaned. Not asked-for. Ours. The coalition counts 3 blades against THE HERALD — it needs 10.
